sources.claim_and_scope: Music representations from acoustic and musical self-supervision; sequence-level MIR performance does not establish fine-grained LightSem motion transfer. Local control uses the330M checkpoint,75 Hz features and layers15/16.
sources.title: MERT: Acoustic Music Understanding Model with Large-Scale Self-supervised Training

sources.claim_and_scope: Mel-RVQ targets and layer-specific music representations motivate a frozen encoder test. The public MSD release is distinct from the large-data paper model; the study uses25 Hz native features and FP32 extraction.
sources.title: MuQ: Self-Supervised Music Representation Learning with Mel Residual Vector Quantization

sources.claim_and_scope: Token-level tasks and longer context reveal strengths not captured by global music tagging. This is a reason to test local temporal behavior, not proof of useful dance conditioning.
sources.title: A Foundation Model for Music Informatics

sources.claim_and_scope: Intermediate layers can be better suited to downstream tasks than default final-layer or all-layer aggregation. The reported tasks do not directly establish beat or LightSem motion quality.
sources.title: Layer-wise Investigation of Large-Scale Self-Supervised Music Representation Models

sources.authors: Kanatas, Kong, Alonso-Jiménez, Serra and Bogdanov
sources.claim_and_scope: Across12 models and15 tasks, intrinsic geometric criteria are task-dependent. Effective rank or representation spread alone is not a universal quality certificate.
sources.title: What Makes a Good Layer? Assessing the Layer-Wise Intrinsic Properties of Music Foundation Models

sources.claim_and_scope: General audio representation learning with acoustic tokenizers; the name BEATs does not denote a music beat tracker.
sources.title: BEATs: Audio Pre-Training with Acoustic Tokenizers

sources.claim_and_scope: Audio-text alignment supports semantic transfer but is not a direct validation of frame-local rhythm or motion control.
sources.title: Large-scale Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining with Feature Fusion and Keyword-to-Caption Augmentation

sources.claim_and_scope: Audio-visual pretraining yields audio representations; local sliding-window use is possible. One-second aggregation should be distinguished from precise within-window timing.
sources.title: Look, Listen and Learn More: Design Choices for Deep Audio Embeddings

sources.claim_and_scope: Tempo-aware and beat-jitter negatives, motion contacts and bar structure motivate harder local controls. Inputs are pooled to one token per beat and rely on3D motion; released usable weights were not verified on the project page. This is a future mechanism, not an executed checkpoint comparison.
sources.title: MotionBeat: Motion-Aligned Music Representation via Embodied Contrastive Learning and Bar-Equivariant Contact-Aware Encoding

sources.claim_and_scope: Octave-folded periodicity exposes cyclic tempo relations while losing absolute tempo octave. Keep unfolded frequency information alongside cyclic summaries.
sources.title: Cyclic Tempogram—A Mid-level Tempo Representation for Music Signals

sources.claim_and_scope: Local Fourier periodicity and phase support a time-varying pulse estimate. Benefit over a fixed grid must be checked on annotated music rather than inferred from the method definition.
sources.title: Extracting Predominant Local Pulse Information from Music Recordings

sources.claim_and_scope: Joint phase and magnitude deviations motivate phase-sensitive novelty computed from the original complex STFT. This uses information absent from an existing magnitude-only cache.
sources.title: Complex Domain Onset Detection for Musical Signals

sources.claim_and_scope: Spectrogram structure can support harmonic/percussive decomposition. It does not provide oracle source stems or establish motion predictability.
sources.title: Harmonic/Percussive Separation Using Median Filtering

sources.claim_and_scope: Beat F1 and continuity are distinct evaluation axes. The released final0 checkpoint is a comparative tracker, not ground-truth annotation, and overlap with GuitarSet is unverified here.
sources.title: Beat This! Accurate Beat Tracking Without DBN Postprocessing

sources.claim_and_scope: Music-conditioned diffusion with cross-attention and physical/diversity checks illustrates the need to evaluate several motion-quality axes. It does not validate this study's FiLM intervention or lighting adapter.
sources.title: EDGE: Editable Dance Generation From Music

sources.claim_and_scope: Audio-associated movement is ambiguous and is appropriately treated probabilistically. Conditional mean reconstruction and distributional generation answer different questions.
sources.title: Listen, Denoise, Action! Audio-Driven Motion Synthesis with Diffusion Models

sources.claim_and_scope: Feature-wise affine modulation is a general conditioning mechanism. Transfer to repeated audio conditioning in this temporal flow is an experimentally tested hypothesis.
sources.title: FiLM: Visual Reasoning with a General Conditioning Layer

sources.claim_and_scope: Independent microphone audio and beat-position JAMS annotations. This study uses358 of 360 performances after excluding two known timing problems, and verifies every original WAV/JAMS MD5.
sources.title: GuitarSet v1.1.0

sources.claim_and_scope: Published timing problems motivate the two predefined whole-file exclusions:04_BN3-154-E_comp and04_Jazz1-200-B_comp.
sources.title: Annotation/audio timing issue 5

sources.claim_and_scope: The exact public MSD release used for feature extraction. Checkpoint metadata has CC-BY-NC 4.0; code licensing is separate. All 525 loaded tensors matched the pinned checkpoint.
sources.title: MuQ-large-msd-iter released model

sources.claim_and_scope: Local Fourier coefficients of novelty retain frequency and phase information. A deterministic transformation of an existing envelope changes its representation, not its Shannon information content.
sources.title: Fourier Tempogram
